cart/info/basic.description: happy path: default fields without any selector -- narrower than {*}, returns just name and url

cart/info/error-invalid-response-fields.description: error: empty {} response_fields selector fails the field-list pattern -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

cart/info/rf-all.description: full response shape: connected retailer account, single Bol store, retailer_data (VAT/KVK/rating) and economic_operators

cart/info/rf-name.description: field selection: only the retailer display name

cart/info/rf-stores-info-store-id-name-c.description: field selection: single connected store with its id, name and currency, without the full carrier/warehouse detail

cart/info/rf-url.description: field selection: only the storefront url

order/info/basic.description: full response shape: single shipped order with customer, addresses, totals and line items

order/info/error-empty-order-id.description: error: order_id present but empty -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

order/info/error-not-found.description: error: well-formed but non-existent order_id -> 112 ENTITY_NOT_FOUND

order/info/rounding-precision-2.description: rounding_precision applied to the totals breakdown

order/list/basic.description: happy path: default fields for all 7 orders currently on the store, all in shipped status

order/return.add/error-not-yet-shipped.description: an item can only be returned after it has shipped

order/return.add/error-quantity-over-ava.description: returning more units than were shipped on that order line

order/shipment.add/check-process-status.description: wait for bol.com to finish creating the shipment rather than returning once it is queued

order/shipment.add/error-all-items-shipp.description: nothing left to ship on an order that is already fully shipped -- checked before any per-item validation

order/shipment.add/error-multiple-tracki.description: a bol.com shipment carries exactly one track and trace code

order/shipment.add/error-order-item-not-.description: not found: the order_product_id does not belong to this order

order/shipment.add/error-quantity-over-a.description: shipping more units than the order line still has outstanding

order/shipment.add/items-subset.description: partial shipment: name the order items and quantities instead of shipping the whole order

order/shipment.info/basic.description: happy path: single shipment by id, tracking number and recipient shipment_details

order/shipment.info/error-empty-id.description: error: id present but empty -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

order/shipment.info/error-not-found.description: error: well-formed but non-existent shipment id -> 112 ENTITY_NOT_FOUND

order/shipment.list/basic.description: full response shape: the single TNT shipment for a shipped order, tracking number and recipient shipment_details

order/shipment.list/error-count-over-lim.description: error: count over 50 -> Bol-specific limit, 107 STORE_ERROR

order/shipment.list/error-empty-order-id.description: error: order_id present but empty -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

order/status.list/basic.description: the two Bol order statuses (open/shipped) -- order_status values order.list accepts

order/update/error-already-shipped.description: an order stops being cancellable once any item has shipped

order/update/error-order-status-required.description: validation: order_id alone is not enough, order_status must say what to do

order/update/order-status-cancelled.description: happy path: cancel an order that has nothing shipped yet; the order id is a format-correct placeholder, not a captured one

product/add/basic.description: happy path: create a new-condition offer for an existing EAN

product/add/error-condition-not-allowed.description: validation: condition outside the five grades bol.com recognises

product/add/tier-prices.description: bulk pricing instead of a flat price: quantity thresholds must decrease in price and none may be 1

product/count/basic.description: total product count for the connected retailer catalog

product/count/modified-from-2026-08-12.description: filter: products modified since a given date

product/delete/error-not-found.description: not found: no offer with this id

product/delete/id-b7f2c1d4-3e58-4a90-9c6.description: happy path: delete the offer created by product.add

product/info/basic.description: full response shape: single product by id, including images, additional_fields and custom_fields

product/info/error-empty-id.description: error: id present but empty -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

product/info/error-not-found.description: error: well-formed but non-existent product id -> 112 ENTITY_NOT_FOUND

product/list/basic.description: happy path: default fields, first page of 10 products from the live catalog

product/list/error-invalid-count.description: error: count must be an unsigned integer -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

product/list/lang-id-nl.description: filter: product data in a specific store language (NL)

product/list/page-2.description: pagination: second page via page_cursor from basic

product/list/rf-all.description: full response shape: single product with images, additional_fields (Bol offer/condition data) and custom_fields (GPSR manufacturer/EU economic operator attributes)

product/update/check-process-status.description: wait for bol.com to finish processing the change before answering, instead of returning as soon as it is queued

product/update/error-name-already-known.description: the title is fixed once bol.com has catalog content for the product; only offers on unknown products keep an editable title

product/update/error-not-found.description: not found: no offer with this id

product/update/error-quantity-over-limit.description: validation: the 999-unit stock cap applies to updates as well as adds

product/update/no-changes.description: submitting the offer's current values changes nothing and reports updated_items 0

product/update/price-and-quantity.description: happy path: change price and stock on a retailer-fulfilled offer

product/update/status-disabled.description: take an offer off sale without deleting it

return/info/basic.description: full response shape: single unhandled return, customer reason/comment and the returned line item

return/info/error-empty-id.description: error: id present but empty -> 109 PARAM_ERROR

return/info/error-not-found.description: error: well-formed but non-existent return id -> 112 ENTITY_NOT_FOUND

return/list/basic.description: happy path: default fields (id + order_products) for the first page of return requests

return/list/status-unhandled.description: filter: status=unhandled -- the single return still awaiting action
